i.h: Republican Mike Kelly wins reelection to U.S. House in Pennsylvania's 16th Congressional District

i.x: We ran a good campaign and generated a 19.5-point swing left, the largest shift anywhere in PA from 2024. People don't want corruption or corporate interference in their elections. Money from foreign and out of Commonwealth PACs are toxic to healthy democracy. #democracy #ForThePeopleNotThePower

Alright, PA-16. Already voted? Great. Still planning to? You’ve got until 8 PM. And if you’ve got a friend who keeps saying they’ll get around to it, this is your reminder to check in on them. Find your polling place at vote.pa.gov #electionday #voteforaveteran #PA16

To everyone on my team...everyone on #TeamJustin I am so grateful for everything that you have done for me, for democracy. You've done what so many others won't or don't. And that's something, you stood. No matter what happens on election day, we can all stand tall. THANK YOU
